> COMMAND_LONG  command=400 (ARM_DISARM) param1=1 confirmation=0

< STATUSTEXT    severity=2 text="PreArm: Battery 1 below minimum arming voltage"
options: The command was rejected by a pre-arm check: the reason is in STATUSTEXT, the voltage is below the arming threshold
The script did not wait for the ACK: result=4 means "in progress", wait longer
